description: Source code for the DU Processor Repository class, managing DU instances, including adding, removing, and querying DUs, as well as handling metrics and UEs.

classes.name: du_processor_repository
classes.description: Repository class managing DU instances, providing methods to add, remove, find, and query DUs, as well as handling metrics and UEs.

methods.name: add_du
methods.description: Adds a new DU instance, creates and initializes the DU processor, and returns its index.

methods.name: remove_du
methods.description: Removes a DU instance asynchronously, stopping its activity and erasing it from the database.

methods.name: get_next_du_index
methods.description: Finds the next available DU index within the maximum allowed.

methods.name: find_du
methods.description: Finds a DU index by PCI or by global cell ID.

methods.name: find_du_processor
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the DU processor for a given DU index, or nullptr if not found.

methods.name: get_du_processor
methods.description: Returns a reference to the DU processor for a given DU index, asserting its existence.

methods.name: get_du_processor_indexes
methods.description: Returns a list of all DU indexes currently managed.

methods.name: handle_du_metrics_report_request
methods.description: Generates a report of DU metrics if RRC metrics are enabled.

methods.name: get_nof_f1ap_ues
methods.description: Returns the total number of UEs connected via F1AP across all DUs.

methods.name: get_nof_rrc_ues
methods.description: Returns the total number of UEs connected via RRC across all DUs.
